Entry 8: Fugitives Part 2: Anastasia
Full name: Anastasia Michaela Engelhart (born Dionysia Anastasia Megalou)
Known as: Anastasia
Height: 10' 10" (330.2 centimeters)
Weight: 1000 pounds (453.59 kilograms)
Birthplace: Néa Athína, Greece, Mars
Residence Prior to Wartime: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States, Earth
Residence Now: Unknown
Parents (Alive or Dead): Menelaos Megalos and Eleni Megalou
Marital Status: Married
Spouse(s): Uzziah Engelhart (known as: Uzziah, Augustus, August)
Parents-in-Law (Alive or Dead): Nehemiah Engelhart Sr. and Golda Engelhart 
Number of Children (Alive or Dead): 5 (Agathangelos, Malachias, Apostolis, Agapi, and Sophia)
Crime(s): Conscription Evasion
Bounty Award: 100 pounds of  beans
Threat Level: 6/10
Reasons for Assigned Threat Level: Anastasia is the tallest and strongest person to ever live.
She is deceptively quick, can lift twice her body weight, and can run through any structure no matter its material.
Any bullet more powerful than a 9mm parabellum round will damage her, but anything less is deflected off her body.
The only reasons that she isn't a 10, are that she is reported to have a learning disability, 
she appears to not be a person with a violent nature, nor a particularly evil one,
she doesn't appear to want to fight back most of the time and is more likely to run away from a percieved threat,
and she appears to be in intense fear when men are present, but not at all when women are.
Instructions For Citizens: If you see her, call the authorities. 
Don't try stopping her yourself. 
To be safe, don't go too near her. 
She may not be trying to hurt anyone, but she could on accident and she doesn't deserve to be in any more fear.
